_comment: Atlas Growth AU :: FIFTH RECOVERY pass over excluded_officp.csv — the NO-TYPE track (GATE 3 proposal P2, 2026-09-20). Google returned an EMPTY google_types on a small set of listings ('Reblocking Kings' Hadfield, 'Always Level Reblocking' Meadow Heights, 'Foundation Solutions' Birkdale, 'Advanced Reblocking Specialists' Footscray, 'Quicklift Reblocking' Warragul): 9 Australian rows with an ICP name and no category at all. The main pass drops them as not_in_icp (no type can match the allow) and the generic recovery cannot see them either (no type can match its net). qualify-leads.js has a `not_exists` op that works on any column, so the pass is: dropped at the allow AND google_types empty AND an ICP token in the name. Nothing else can arrive here.

qualify_rules._r: 1. EMPTY google_types only — a typed row belongs to the main allow or the generic recovery, never here.
qualify_rules.label: has_type

qualify_rules._r: 2. The NAME must claim the work — same token list as recover-generic-au-config.json rule 2.
qualify_rules.label: name_not_icp
